guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 核对 Solana 钱包资金要求
guide.description: 原文建议使用 Phantom 或 Solflare，预留 SOL 用于网络手续费、打赏及付费 Pass 等级。交易所推广已省略；购买或投入资金前核对规则。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Install Phantom or Solflare and keep a small amount of SOL in it for network fees, tips, and any paid Pass tier. You can buy SOL on Bybit and withdraw straight to your Solana address.

guide.title: 查看铸造页的钱包连接说明
guide.description: 原文要求进入 Memebook 铸造页，连接钱包并签署验证消息；XP 绑定钱包地址而非用户名，因此需使用同一钱包。签名前核对完整消息。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect Your Wallet to the Mint Page
guide.original_description: Open the Memebook mint page , connect the wallet you just funded, and sign the verification message. Use this same wallet throughout, since XP is tied to the address rather than a username.

guide.title: 核对 X 与 Telegram 账号验证
guide.description: 原文称铸造前需要关联并验证这两个账号，包括关注 Memebook 的 X 账号、加入 Telegram 频道。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Verify Your X and Telegram Accounts
guide.original_description: Link both accounts on the mint page. Verification is required before minting and includes following the Memebook X account and joining the Telegram channel.

guide.title: 了解 Memebook Pass 铸造
guide.description: 原文称 Bronze 等级免费并提供应用访问权；付费等级提高 XP 倍数和每日限额。Pass 为不可转让的绑定凭证，绑定铸造钱包，不能转售。免费等级仍需核对网络费用。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Bronze is free and gets you into the app. Paid tiers raise your XP multiplier and daily limits, which compounds across every post. The Pass is soulbound, so it stays attached to the minting wallet and cannot be resold.

guide.title: 查看 Android 应用
guide.description: 原文称可从 Google Play 下载 Memebook，用持有 Pass 的钱包登录；目前没有 iOS 版本，应用内任务需要 Android 设备。应用归属与当前可用版本待核验。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Download Memebook from Google Play and sign in with the wallet holding your Pass. There is no iOS build, so an Android device is required for the in-app half of the campaign.

guide.title: 了解每日发布与互动任务
guide.description: 原文建议发布照片或短视频、点赞评论其他创作者、每日签到，并称跨多日活动比单次集中活动获得更多积分。积分不保证可兑换代币。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Publish photos or reels, like and comment on other creators, and complete the daily check-in. Spreading activity across days earns more than dumping the same volume into one session.

guide.title: 了解创作者打赏与邀请关系
guide.description: 原文称以 SOL 打赏帖子属于链上活动并计入活跃度；分享应用邀请链接，当被邀请用户铸造 Pass 时可获得 XP。打赏是资金支出，奖励规则尚需核验。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Tip Creators and Share Your Invite Code
guide.original_description: Send SOL tips to posts you like, which is an on-chain action and counts toward your activity. Then share your invite link from the app to earn XP when someone you referred mints a Pass.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
